copy.tagline: 追踪AI产品质量随时间的变化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要持续监控AI产品的性能漂移和退化
copy.tagline_en: Track AI product quality over time
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to continuously monitor AI product performance drift and degradation

howto.what: 安装后，Claude会定期评估AI产品的质量指标，监控模型更新、数据漂移等变化，并生成趋势报告和漂移预警。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行质量跟踪、检测退化，或按设定时间表自动运行时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置黄金测试集来追踪质量变化。
say.note: Claude将创建固定测试输入并安排定期评估。

say.text: 检查最近一周的质量趋势，是否有漂移？
say.note: Claude会调取仪表盘并分析最新数据。

say.text: 检测到质量退化时，应该怎么应对？

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will periodically evaluate AI product quality metrics, monitor changes like model updates and data drift, and generate trend reports and drift alerts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users request quality tracking or degradation detection, or automatically based on a scheduled routine.

say_en.text: Set up a golden test set to track quality changes.
say_en.note: Claude will create fixed test inputs and schedule regular evaluations.

say_en.text: Check quality trends for the past week; any drift?
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve dashboards and analyze latest data.

say_en.text: What should I do if quality degrades?
say_en.note: Claude will outline drift response steps.
